text:
```yaml
name: Document Meeting Minutes

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 0 * * 1' # Runs every Monday at midnight UTC

jobs:
  update-meeting-minutes:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Set up Go
        uses: actions/setup-go@v2
        with:
          go-version: '1.17'

      - name: Fetch latest changes from Discourse
        run: |
          curl -L https://discourse.layer5.io/latest.json?category=community > discourse_latest.json

      - name: Parse latest meeting minute
        id: parse_minutes
        run: |
          jq '.topic_list.topics[0].posts[-1].cooked' discourse_latest.json > latest_minute.html

      - name: Add parsed meeting minute to archive
        run: |
          mkdir -p .github/meetings/archive
          mv latest_minute.html .github/meetings/archive/

      - name: Commit and push changes
        run: |
          git add .github/meetings/archive/latest_minute.html
          git commit -m "Update weekly meeting minutes"
          git push origin main
```
